ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels occupying approximately 65-70% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the lateral margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs on the lateral edges of both lobes. Left lobe shows a distinct white vertical band at the distal third. Right lobe features an irregular white patch with significant black speckling/mottling at the distal end.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow pixel angle (~40-45 degrees) and deep central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more irregular, higher-amplitude serrations and distinct jagged notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch to the lateral tips; the trailing edge maintains a generally horizontal orientation with a slight posterior curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacle-like structures) localized at the extreme distal tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of light-intensity linear pixel tracks (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the central dark pigment regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring/rake marks covering a significant portion of the dark central pigmentation; irregular serrations on the right trailing edge indicating possible minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense overlapping linear abrasion pattern across the central peduncle area and medial fluke surfaces.
